highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: It includes variable and color fonts, animated WebP encoding, configurable surface sampling, and a reworked singleton lifecycle. Pixel access, typeface initialization, SKPath finalization, Android GL views, and WinUI loading are more reliable. This is a breaking release; review the migration notes before upgrading.

breaking.title: Legacy SKPaint APIs and other pre-v4 obsoletes are now errors
breaking.body: Legacy `SKPaint` text and font state members are now compile errors, and remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are trimmed from reference assemblies. Move typeface, text size, hinting, and text encoding to `SKFont`, use the `SKCanvas.DrawText` overloads that accept it, and replace other obsolete APIs before upgrading.

breaking.title: Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed
breaking.body: The Skia m147 update removes the EOL Tizen arm and x86 native builds. Move Tizen deployments to the `tizen-arm64` or `tizen-x64` assets.

breaking.title: WASM native assets require .NET 8 or later
breaking.body: Native assets for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are removed. Retarget Blazor WASM and Uno Platform WASM projects on .NET 6 or .NET 7 to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: new SKFont() uses an empty typeface
breaking.body: A parameterless `SKFont` now contains `SKTypeface.Empty`, so text measures as zero and draws nothing until a typeface is assigned. Construct it with `SKTypeface.Default` or another explicit typeface, and use `Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of a null check.

breaking.title: SKPaint and SKTypeface fallback semantics changed
breaking.body: `new SKPaint().Typeface` now returns `SKTypeface.Default`, and `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` returns the default rather than null for a missing family on Android. Replace paint null checks with the appropriate `IsEmpty` logic; use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily` when a strict no-match null result is required.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) rejects offsets outside the 32-bit range
breaking.body: The obsolete `SKStream.Move(long)` overload now throws `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating an out-of-range offset. Validate the value and call `Move(int)`.

breaking.title: Vulkan Ganesh requires Vulkan 1.1
breaking.body: `GRContext.CreateVulkan` now terminates the process for a Vulkan 1.0 context instead of returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` to the same supported version; choose another backend up front on Vulkan 1.0-only hardware.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative removes legacy fields
breaking.body: The native Vulkan context removes `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Delete those assignments, use `fVkExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures` or `fDeviceFeatures2`, and manage instance and device ownership outside the context.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion types and layout changed
breaking.body: `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` becomes `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`, loses its value-equality members, and gains a `Components` field through the new `GRVkYcbcrComponents` layout. Update type references, equality code, manual construction, and native-layout assumptions.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only
breaking.body: The protected setter is removed from `IgnorePublicDispose`. Derived wrappers can no longer change it after construction and should select the appropriate disposal behavior in their constructor path.

breaking.title: Assembly version advances to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and hard-coded assembly-version checks.

bullets.lead: Skia advances from m119 to m148
bullets.detail: The bundled engine spans the m132, m133, and m147 upgrades through m148, bringing codec orientation, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, CICP color spaces, newer filters, and accumulated rendering fixes.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp can query variation axes, clone typefaces at design coordinates, select built-in palettes, and override individual palette colors.
Updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz to newer upstream releases.
`SKWebpEncoder` adds single-frame and animated encoding overloads, with frame durations represented by `SKWebpEncoderFrame`.
`SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface` gain `SKSamplingOptions` overloads for choosing filtering and mipmap behavior.

bullets.lead: Zero-copy access to memory-backed stream data
bullets.detail: `SKStream.GetData()` returns the backing `SKData` when the native stream can expose it cheaply.

bullets.lead: New document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs
bullets.detail: Adds `SKDocument.CreateXps`, per-resource `GRContext.Flush`, `SKMaskFilter.CreateShader`, `SKColorSpace.CreateCicp`, HDR color types, and the correctly ordered `HBColor` value type.

bullets.lead: Pixel spans honor row bytes and coordinates
bullets.detail: `SKPixmap` and `SKBitmap` pixel spans now use `RowBytes` for stride, while `GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y)` computes its offset with the correct axis.
Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font-manager path, avoiding Android API 36 startup crashes and returning an empty typeface as a safe last resort.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer races its builder
bullets.detail: Disposal no longer flushes a collected `SKPathBuilder`, preventing a finalizer-thread native crash.

bullets.lead: Platform view and projection loading fixed
bullets.detail: Android `SKGLView` retains its dimensions across navigation and tab switches, and .NET 9 WinUI consumers can load the Projection assembly from the package.

bullets.lead: Font and stream edge cases corrected
bullets.detail: Undersized variable-font spans report correct write counts, glyph checks avoid infinite recursion, and negative stream moves preserve the correct native value.
Process-wide wrappers now use a managed lifecycle with coordinated ownership, disposal, and finalization across singleton object graphs.

bullets.lead: Native compatibility check runs on first API use
bullets.detail: The compatibility gate moves from a module initializer to the `SkiaApi` type constructor, avoiding module-load failures for applications that never use SkiaSharp.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic assets for x64 and arm64
bullets.detail: Dedicated `linux-bionic` runtime assets support Android-hosted Linux environments for both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp.
Adds official `tizen-x64` and `tizen-arm64` package assets while the Skia m147 transition retires 32-bit Tizen builds.

bullets.lead: Apple libraries target the base 26.0 SDK
bullets.detail: Versioned library TFMs use 26.0 for broader Xcode 26 compatibility, while apps use unversioned Apple TFMs.
The WebAssembly package removes native assets for older Emscripten versions and now supports the .NET 8-or-later toolchain.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia m132 and m147 updates, variable fonts, managed default typefaces, singleton lifecycle work, and the SKPath finalizer fix
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and C# 13 support for legacy target frameworks
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Android SKGLView rendering after MAUI TabBar switches and navigation

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Moves the assembly to v4 and Skia to m147, removes 32-bit Tizen assets, and makes oversized `SKStream.Move` offsets fail explicitly. Adds variable fonts, color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets, while changing default typeface semantics and fixing Android GL view reattachment.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and zero-copy access to memory-backed stream data, fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and broadens Apple SDK compatibility.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Requires .NET 8 or later for WASM native assets and renames `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`. Adds `HBColor`, XPS creation, per-resource GPU flushes, and shader mask filters while refreshing bundled native libraries.

v4.148.0-rc.1.2.summary: Updates to Skia m148, reworks singleton lifecycles, makes legacy `SKPaint` members compile errors, and removes the `SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose` setter. Fixes pixel access and WinUI projection loading.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 updates the bundled HarfBuzz from 8.3.1.6, adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces `HBColor`, and gains Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets with reworked singleton lifecycle behavior.
